1935.unvetted: needs Chrome: https://manuscripts.nls.uk/repositories/2/archival_objects/53544 (NLS 403). MS.12551 is Minto's 1885 telegram book, 73 leaves, 'some in cipher'; the record does not say which entries or how much, so ciphertext is not shown and it may be a commercial telegraph code; a search of NLS/Kew gave no decipherment. Needs the leaves.

1936.unvetted: needs Chrome: https://manuscripts.nls.uk/repositories/2/resources/15305 (NLS 403). Adv.MS.19.3.4 (190 ff., c.1652-3) has 'several pages written in cypher or shorthand' at the rear; the catalogue itself cannot tell cipher from shorthand, so the leaves must be seen. Three searches (shelfmark, Lady Reay, poems) found no study of those pages.
